fusions.name: Page Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a sheet that deals 4 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Rustling Leaves
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of loose pages that deals 28 damage to everything caught in it, ignoring resistances. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Written Warning
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Second Draft
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
